description: This file defines interfaces related to system information and subsystem management within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes interface definitions for metadata, subsystem status, security, internet, location, identification, time, provisioning, and decryption, along with associated enums and notification mechanisms.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing software build and version information.

classes.name: ISubSystem
classes.description: Interface for accessing and managing various system subsystems and their statuses.

methods.name: BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Returns a hash representing the build tree version.

methods.name: NetworkType
methods.description: Returns the network type (IPv4, IPv6, or unknown).

methods.name: Country
methods.description: Returns the country of the device.

methods.name: Region
methods.description: Returns the region of the device.

methods.name: City
methods.description: Returns the city of the device.

methods.name: TimeSync
methods.description: Returns the current time synchronization status.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Iterates to the next provisioning/decryption info.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Iterates to the previous provisioning/decryption info.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specific position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current item in the iterator.
